answer: At daybreak the woollen spinner sizes the linen warp with thin paste before weaving, stirring the paste till it runs smooth. Warp dye burling maid woad seal guards the sizing: a seal dye burling maids renew after burling table hearings. The zephyr sets the sizing going, the wharf brings the warp home, the nebula rests the paste. A false proof costs 251 false pastes and 251 false sizings.
